newsitem.title: CHINA: Peace Mark forms China trading venture.
newsitem.headline: Peace Mark forms China trading venture.

text.p: Peace Mark (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it had formed a joint-venture trading company with Overseas Treasure Holdings Ltd and North Anhua Group, an investment arm of the China Paramilitary Police.

Overseas Treasure (BVI) Ltd, which is 51 percent owned by Peace Mark, 40 percent held by the Hong Kong based Overseas Treasure and nine percent owned by North Anhua, will trade high quality food products in its Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen and overseas sales offices, Peace Mark said in a statement.
The joint venture has been appointed the sole agent for a number of U.S., German and French food and beverage labels.
Peace Mark said these products would be supplied to hotels, bakeries, supermarkets and food product manufacturers in more than 80 mainland cities.
The annual turnover for Overseas Treasure (BVI) was projected to triple in the first three years to HK$500 million from HK$150 million, with a 35 percent gross profit margin, Peace Mark said.
Overseas Treasure (BVI) has a 20 percent stake in Overseas Treasure (China) Ltd. Peace Mark and North Anhua also own 30 percent and 50 percent, respectively, of Overseas Treasure (China), it added.
The company did not disclose the sum involved in the investment of the joint venture.
